title: DNA extraction and Nested PCR
author: Baiyan Gong1
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yvjfw4n
materials: DNA extraction Genomic DNA of E. bieneusi was extracted directly from 180 to 200 mg of each fecal specimen using the recommended procedures and the provided reagents by the manufacture of QIAamp DNA Stool Mini Kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany). To obtain high yield of DNA, the lysis temperature was increased to 95 ° C according to the manufacturer’s suggestion. DNA was eluted in 200 μL of AE and stored at −20°C before it was used for PCR analysis.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine to a final volume of 25 µL: 17 µL DNase/RNase‑Free deionized water, 0.5 µL of each primer, 0.5 µL TaKaRa Taq DNA Polymerase (TaKaRa Bio Inc., Tokyo, Japan), 2.5 µL 10 × PCR buffer, 2 µL 10 mmol dNTP mix, and 2 µL DNA template.

steps.title: First‑round PCR initial denaturation
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a thermocycler and run an initial denaturation at 95 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Second‑round PCR initial denaturation
steps.instruction: Using the product from the first reaction as template, add the second set of primers (volumes as in master mix) and run an initial denaturation at 95 °C for 5 minutes (00:05:00).

steps.title: Cool reaction to hold temperature
steps.instruction: After the final cycle, lower the thermocycler temperature to 4–15 °C (or 4 °C) and hold indefinitely for short‑term storage of the PCR products.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Prepare a 1.5 % agarose gel, load all secondary PCR products, run electrophoresis, stain the gel with GelStrain (TransGen Biotech., Beijing, China), and visualize the bands.
